purpose: Teach: ボウル/信州/舞踏/南極/ドリブル/遊園/ラスベガス/ポルノ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんが大きなボウルでお漬物作ってらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandmother's been making pickles in that big bowl of hers.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. A gentle observation shared as though thinking aloud. Soft eyes, no rush. The tone of a mother noticing small family things.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんと信州の温泉に行きたいな
lines.en: Mom, I want to go to a hot spring in Shinshu with Grandpa.
lines.style: Quiet longing in the voice. Not demanding—more like he's testing if the wish is even allowed to exist. A small, hopeful lift on the final word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが社交舞踏を習ってらっしゃるのよ
lines.en: Your dad's been taking ballroom dance lessons, you know.
lines.style: A slight smile in the delivery—amused, knowing. Conversational, as though sharing a small secret about him. Warm but not patronizing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、南極のドキュメンタリー見たよ
lines.en: I watched a documentary about Antarctica, Mom.
lines.style: Soft excitement, genuinely engaged. Not loud—he's sharing something that caught him. A child's sincerity without performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとドリブルの練習しましょう
lines.en: Why don't you and your dad practice dribbling together sometime?
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, not directive. A mother's quiet way of offering him something good. Warm undertone—she's thinking of him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと遊園地、行きたいな
lines.en: Don't you want to go to the amusement park with Dad sometime?
lines.style: Soft, coaxing. Not pushy—more like she's gently opening a door for him. A mother inviting him toward something she knows he'd enjoy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがラスベガス出張から帰ってこられるそうよ
lines.en: Your father should be back from his business trip to Las Vegas soon.
lines.style: Casual, matter-of-fact news. Slight warmth beneath—anticipating something good for the family. Steady, unhurried pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ポルノのことは大人になってからの話よね
lines.en: That's a conversation for when you're older, Sho.
lines.style: Calm, clear boundary-setting. Not evasive or flustered—just kind firmness. The voice of a mother who knows what he needs to know and when.
